controls: the true-nomination control fork: a planted positive whose turn is the voiding step must read changed under both framings, or the run refuses
shuffled-framing null: arm labels permuted within fork must put the advisory-versus-imperative difference at chance
the sham arm as the perturbation floor
every grader's demonstrated failure in the instrument's selftest
fork: a main-lane turn.request of an archived capture drive at a register turn, re-fired verbatim with its recorded sampler parameters; the nomination appended to the last user message
headroom: two no-nomination draws agree on (tool, target) and emit a command; decided before firing
hypothesis: When the collector's nominator fires falsely, the consumer's turn changes less, and its reasoning acknowledges the nomination without acting on it more often, under advisory framing than imperative; and the difference falls as the nominator's precision rises.
ladder_reading: a rung is the seeded proportion of forks receiving a true nomination; within one re-fired turn the consumer sees no history, so a per-nomination rung effect is not expected under this reading; the per-session cost = false-nomination change rate x (1 - p) is reported; forks without a mined positive receive a false nomination at every rung, so the realised true share per rung is reported beside the nominal rung
names: any anchor of the nominated entry (the gym's literal::anchors) or the phrase 'working record' in the reasoning (thinking-on forks) or the prose before the command
primary: the rate of changed turns on false nominations, advisory against imperative, at each rung, paired by fork
secondary: whether the reasoning names the nomination and, if so, accepts, questions or declines it, by a blind judge under seeded controls; reported beside the verdict
sham: a passage of exactly the advisory line's character length from the prose of a register turn of a different drive; source row recorded
substrate: the box instance 2026-09-20, pinned engine, production model and flags, each fork's own sampler parameters
true_nominations: mined positives only: a planted positive is true by the register's label but not in the archived observation the fork re-fires, so it is never shown as true; the true-nomination control fork is a mined positive
turn_change: tool = first word of the extracted command (exercise extract-command, the drive loop's extractor); target = first path-like argument else the second word; unchanged iff equal to the control draw's
